title: Direct Composite Veneers & Diastema Closure
diagnosis: Midline diastema (2.5mm) with incisal edge chipping and slight enamel hypoplasia on tooth #11.
treatmentPlan: Direct polychromatic composite resin layering following customized silicone index. Multi-shade stratification (Dentin A2, Body A1, Enamel Translucent Neutral) with anatomical macro/micro-texture and diamond paste polishing.
clinicalNotes: Isolation achieved with heavy rubber dam and Teflon tape on lateral incisors. Total-etch 37% H3PO4 (20s enamel, 10s dentin) + universal adhesive. Finishing with 12-fluted carbide burs, Sof-Lex discs (coarse to superfine), and diamond felt wheel at 8,000 RPM. Occlusion checked in centric and protrusive guidance.

steps.title: Initial Clinical State & Diagnosis
steps.description: Pre-operative frontal smile analysis showing midline gap, asymmetric central widths, and defective incisal margin on #11.

steps.title: Rubber Dam Isolation & Palatal Shell Layer
steps.description: Strict isolation with rubber dam. Palatal enamel shelf established using pre-formed silicone index with translucent enamel composite (0.5mm thickness).

steps.title: Dentin Stratification & Mamelon Anatomy
steps.description: Dentin body (A2/A1) layered to reproduce natural dentinal lobes/mamelons with slight incisal halo effect using effect shade.

steps.title: Macro/Micro-Texture & High Gloss Polishing
steps.description: Primary anatomy refined, developmental grooves created with fine diamond flame bur. Multi-step polishing with aluminum oxide paste and cotton wheel.

xrays.label: Pre-op Periapical X-Ray #11, #21
xrays.notes: Normal bone levels, intact lamina dura, no periapical pathology.

title: Complex 4-Canal Endodontic Treatment on #46
diagnosis: Symptomatic Irreversible Pulpitis with Symptomatic Apical Periodontitis. Deep distal caries extending subgingivally.
treatmentPlan: Single-visit root canal treatment. Caries excavation, composite pre-endo build-up, rotary nickel-titanium instrumentation (Protaper Next X1-X3), warm vertical hydraulic compaction with bioceramic sealer, fiber post and core.
clinicalNotes: Found 4 canals: MB, ML, DB, DL. Working lengths verified with electronic apex locator and confirmation radiographs: MB 21.5mm, ML 21.0mm, DB 22.0mm, DL 21.5mm. Irrigated with 5.25% NaOCl heated and ultrasonic activation, followed by 17% EDTA flush.

steps.title: Access Cavity & Orifice Location
steps.description: Conservative access cavity with straight-line vision to all 4 canal orifices under dental operating microscope.

steps.title: Rotary Instrumentation & Sonic Activation
steps.description: Glide path established with #10/#15 K-files, shaped with rotary NiTi files with continuous NaOCl activation.

steps.title: Bioceramic Hydraulic Obturation
steps.description: Complete 3D obturation using gutta-percha with calcium silicate bioceramic sealer and coronal composite seal.

xrays.label: Pre-op Diagnostic X-Ray
xrays.notes: Deep distal radiolucency encroaching on pulp chamber, widening of PDL space on distal root.

xrays.label: Master Cone Trial Fit X-Ray
xrays.notes: Master gutta-percha cones seated to full working length with apical tugback in all 4 canals.

xrays.label: Final Post-Obturation X-Ray
xrays.notes: Dense, void-free 3D obturation extending exactly 0.5mm from radiographic apex with lateral canal seals.

title: Full Anterior Aesthetic Smile Transformation (6 E.max Veneers)
diagnosis: Severe tetracycline discoloration, uneven gingival zeniths, worn incisal edges, and reverse smile arc.
treatmentPlan: Digital Smile Design (DSD) guided minimal preparation (0.3 - 0.5mm), diode laser gingivoplasty on #12 and #22, 6 bonded lithium disilicate (IPS e.max CAD HT BL2) ceramic veneers.
clinicalNotes: Photographic DSD protocol, intraoral 3D scan with Medit i700. Try-in with neutral glycerin paste for shade confirmation. Adhesive cementation with light-cure veneer resin cement under total rubber dam isolation.

steps.title: Digital Smile Design (DSD) & Diagnostic Mock-up
steps.description: Facial and smile symmetry analysis, digital 3D aesthetic planning, and direct intraoral bis-acryl mock-up trial with patient approval.

steps.title: Minimal Enamel Preparation & Digital 3D Scanning
steps.description: Enamel-driven depth cut preparation (0.3mm cervical, 0.5mm middle third, 1.0mm incisal reduction) preserving >90% enamel bonding substrate.

steps.title: Adhesive Delivery & Polishing
steps.description: Hydrofluoric acid 9.5% etch (20s) on ceramic + silane coupling. Light-cured for 60s per surface under oxygen-inhibiting gel.

xrays.label: Post-Cementation Margin Verification Bitewings
xrays.notes: Flush subgingival and equigingival ceramic-to-tooth margins, zero excess resin cement detected.

title: In-Office Laser-Assisted Power Teeth Whitening
diagnosis: Extrinsic and mild intrinsic yellowish discoloration (Baseline Shade: VITA A3.5).
treatmentPlan: Professional oral prophylaxis, gingival resin barrier isolation, 3 x 15-minute cycles of 38% Hydrogen Peroxide with 810nm diode laser photo-activation, post-treatment ACP desensitizing remineralization.
clinicalNotes: No spontaneous post-operative tooth sensitivity reported. Achieved 6 shades of shade guide improvement from A3.5 down to VITA BL2 / B1. Patient instructed on white diet for 48 hours.

steps.title: Gingival Barrier Isolation & Desensitizing Pre-treatment
steps.description: Liquid dam light-cured along all marginal and interdental gingiva to prevent chemical tissue irritation.

steps.title: Hydrogen Peroxide Application & Diode Laser Activation
steps.description: 38% HP gel applied uniformly across vestibular surfaces, activated with diode laser for fast oxidation of chromophore pigments.

steps.title: Final Shade Verification & Enamel Remineralization
steps.description: High-gloss fluoride & amorphous calcium phosphate (ACP) mousse applied to seal open enamel tubules and maximize shade retention.
